hints.title: Dug Cell Collection
hints.text: Store the dug coordinates in a lookup collection for constant-time checks.

hints.title: Artifact Cell Validation
hints.text: An artifact is extractable if and only if every single cell it occupies is already present in the dug collection.

hints.title: Bounded Rectangular Cells
hints.text: For an artifact covering [r1, c1] to [r2, c2], verify all cells (r, c) within r1 <= r <= r2 and c1 <= c <= c2.

hints.title: Full Extraction Check

variables: A: number of artifacts (each occupying <= 4 cells)
complexity.notes: Each artifact occupies at most 4 cells according to problem constraints.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching through dig array for each cell of each artifact is O(A * D) and TLEs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set of dug coordinates uses O(D) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate leverages constant-time coordinate lookup and small 4-cell bounding.
